191: Strife and suffering are dispelled by the Guru's Word;
coming and going are ended, and all comforts are obtained. ॥1॥
Fears are dispelled, meditating on the Fearless Lord.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the holy company, I sing the praises of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have enshrined the Lord's lotus feet within my heart;
the Guru has carried me across the ocean of fire. ॥2॥
I was sinking, and the Perfect Guru pulled me out.
I was cut off for so many births, and He has joined me again. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that Guru;
meeting Him, I have been saved. ॥4॥56॥125॥
In the holy company, seek His sanctuary;
place your mind and body before Him. ॥1॥
Drink in the Ambrosial Name, O my brother.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਭ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering, remembering Him, all burning is quenched. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Renounce pride, and end the cycle of birth and death.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
Bow down at the feet of the Lord's servant. ॥2॥
With each and every breath, remember God in your mind.
ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ; ਜੋ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Gather that wealth which shall go along with you. ॥3॥
Only he obtains it, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
Says Nanak, fall at the feet of that one. ॥4॥57॥126॥
In an instant, He turns the dried branches green again.
With His ambrosial glance, He irrigates them and revives them. ॥1॥
The Perfect Divine Guru has removed the suffering
ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ; ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of the servant whom He has blessed with His service. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤ; ਪੁਨੀ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Anxiety is gone, and the hopes of the mind are fulfilled,
when the True Guru, the Treasure of virtue, shows His kindness. ॥2॥
Pain has run away, and peace has come to dwell within;
ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਰੀ; ਜਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
there is no delay when the Guru gives the command. ॥3॥
Desires are fulfilled when one meets the Perfect Guru;
O Nanak, those humble beings bear fruit abundantly. ॥4॥58॥127॥
The fever is gone; God has bestowed peace.
A cooling peace prevails; God has given this gift. ॥1॥
By God's grace, they have become comfortable.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ; ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Separated from Him for countless births, they are reunited with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remembering, remembering the Name of God,
the very home of all disease is destroyed. ॥2॥
In natural poise and love, speak the Word of the Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, remember God, O mortal. ॥3॥
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਜਮੁ; ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Pain, suffering and Death do not even come near
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
— says Nanak — one who sings the Lord's praises. ॥4॥59॥128॥
Blessed are the days, and blessed the occasions,
when one meets the unattached Supreme Lord God. ॥1॥
ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਉ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that time
ਜਿਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ; ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when my mind chants the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful that hour,
when the tongue utters the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥2॥
Fruitful is that forehead which bows to the saints.
Sacred are the feet that walk on the Lord's path. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, blessed is my destiny,
by which I have touched the feet of the Holy. ॥4॥60॥129॥
192: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Keep the Guru's Word in your mind.
Remembering the Name, all anxiety departs. ॥1॥
Without the Lord God, there is no other at all.
The One Lord alone kills and preserves. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Enshrine the Guru's feet in your heart.
Meditating on Him, you shall cross over the ocean of fire. ॥2॥
Focus your meditation on the Guru's form (His Word);
here and hereafter, you shall be honoured. ॥3॥
Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's sanctuary;
my anxieties are ended, and Nanak has found peace. ॥4॥61॥130॥
Remembering Him, all pain is gone,
and the jewel of the Name comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
O my mind, chant the Word of the Lord of the Universe.
ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The holy people chant the Lord's Name with their tongues. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the One Lord, there is no other at all;
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
by His glance of grace, eternal peace is obtained. ॥2॥
Make the One Lord your friend, intimate and companion.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
Inscribe the letters of the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind. ॥3॥
The Lord Master is pervading everywhere.
Nanak sings the praises of the Searcher of hearts. ॥4॥62॥131॥
The whole world is engrossed in fear.
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Only he has no fear, who has the Name as his support. ॥1॥
Fear does not affect one who seeks Your sanctuary.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever pleases You, that alone is done. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In sorrow and joy, people come and go.
ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Only one who is pleasing to God finds peace. ॥2॥
The world is an ocean of fire, where Maya holds great sway.
They alone are cool and calm, who have found the True Guru. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, what can the poor creature do? ॥4॥63॥132॥
By Your grace, one chants Your Name.
By Your grace, one obtains a place in Your court. ॥1॥
Without You, O Supreme Lord God, there is no one.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By Your grace, eternal peace is obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ; ਤਉ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
When You dwell in the mind, no pain touches one.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
By Your grace, doubt and fear run away. ॥2॥
O Supreme Lord God, infinite Master,
I offer this prayer to my True Guru:
that Nanak may be blessed with the Name, the true capital. ॥4॥64॥133॥
As the husk is empty without the grain,
so empty is the mouth without the Name. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
O mortal, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, every day.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, cursed is the body, which shall pass to others. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the Name, no good fortune shows on the face.
Without her husband, where is a bride's happy marriage? ॥2॥
Forgetting the Name, one is attached to other tastes;
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
none of his hopes are fulfilled. ॥3॥
O God, grant Your grace and Your gift,
that Nanak may chant the Name day and night. ॥4॥65॥134॥
193: You are all-powerful; You are my Lord and Master.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ; ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Everything comes from You; You are the Searcher of hearts. ॥1॥
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is the support of His humble servants.
ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Millions are saved in Your sanctuary. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As many creatures as there are — all are Yours.
By Your grace, all sorts of comforts are obtained. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Whatever happens is all according to Your will.
One who understands Your command merges in the True One. ॥3॥
Grant Your grace, O God, and bless me with this gift,
that Nanak may remember the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥66॥135॥
By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision
ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
of one who is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
One within whose mind the Lord dwells
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
does not suffer pain, even in dreams. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All treasures have been placed within the Lord's humble servant.
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
In his company, sins and sorrows depart. ॥2॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The glory of such a humble servant cannot be described;
he is absorbed in the Supreme Lord God. ॥3॥
O God, grant Your grace and hear my prayer:
ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your servant. ॥4॥67॥136॥
Remembering the Lord, your misfortune shall be removed,
and all happiness shall come to dwell in your mind. ॥1॥
Meditate, O my mind, on the One Name alone.
ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੈ; ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It alone shall be of use to your soul. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Night and day, sing the praises of the Infinite Lord,
through the pure teaching of the Perfect Guru. ॥2॥
Renounce other efforts and place your faith in the One.
Taste the ambrosial essence of this supreme treasure. ॥3॥
They alone cross over the treacherous world-ocean,
O Nanak, upon whom He casts His glance of grace. ॥4॥68॥137॥
Those who enshrine God's lotus feet in their hearts
meet the Perfect True Guru and are saved. ॥1॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the Universe, O my brother.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meeting the Holy, meditate on the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Their human body, so hard to obtain, is approved,
who have obtained the insignia of the Name from the True Guru. ॥2॥
Remembering the Lord, the state of perfection is attained.
In the holy company, fear and doubt are dispelled. ॥3॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਤ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading.
Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's sanctuary. ॥4॥69॥138॥
ਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਕੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the dear Guru.
Chanting and chanting the Name of the True Guru, I live. ॥1॥
O Supreme Lord God, Perfect Divine Guru,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਲਾਗਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
show mercy, that I may be committed to Your service. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I enshrine His lotus feet within my heart.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The Guru is the support of my mind, body, wealth and breath of life. ॥2॥
Your life shall be fruitful and approved,
if you know the Guru, the Supreme Lord God, to be near you. ॥3॥
The dust of the feet of the saint is obtained by great good fortune.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭੦॥੧੩੯॥
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥4॥70॥139॥
194: He commits evil deeds and shows himself otherwise;
in the court of the Lord, he shall be bound like a thief. ॥1॥
One who remembers the Lord belongs to the Lord;
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the One Lord is contained in the water, the land and the sky. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
His inner being is filled with poison, yet with his mouth he preaches words of nectar.
Bound in the city of Death, he is punished and beaten. ॥2॥
Behind many screens, he commits sins,
but in an instant they are exposed to the world. ॥3॥
One whose inner being is attuned to the True Name, imbued with its essence —
O Nanak, the Architect of destiny is merciful to him. ॥4॥71॥140॥
ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ; ਕਦੇ ਉਤਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Lord's love never fades away
from one whom the Perfect Guru gives understanding. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
The mind dyed in the Lord's love is true;
ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
dyed a deep crimson, it becomes like the Perfect Being, the Architect of destiny. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who sits in the company of the saints and sings the Lord's praises —
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ; ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Without remembering the Lord, no one has found peace.
All other loves and tastes of Maya are insipid. ॥3॥
Those dyed in love by the Guru are in bliss;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੭੨॥੧੪੧॥
says Nanak, the Guru has become merciful to them. ॥4॥72॥141॥
Remembering the Lord Master, sins are erased,
and one comes to dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ॥1॥
The Lord's humble servants place their trust in the Lord.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਸਭੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chanting the Name, all anxiety is dispelled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the holy company, there is no fear or doubt;
the praises of the Lord of the world are sung there day and night. ॥2॥
In His mercy, God has released them from bondage,
and given them the support of His lotus feet. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, faith has come into their minds,
and His humble servants ever drink in His pure praises. ॥4॥73॥142॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
One whose mind is attached to the Lord's feet —
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
his pain, suffering and doubt run away. ॥1॥
One who deals in the wealth of the Lord is perfect.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One whom He honours is the true spiritual hero. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those to whom the Lord of the world shows mercy
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
fall at the feet of the Guru. ॥2॥
They are blessed with peace, poise, tranquillity and bliss;
chanting and meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, they live. ॥3॥
One who has earned the capital of the Name in the holy company —
says Nanak, God has removed his misfortune. ॥4॥74॥143॥
Remembering the Lord, all troubles are erased.
(Let) His lotus feet enter your mind. ॥1॥
Chant the Lord's Name hundreds of thousands of times,
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and drink in the ambrosial essence, O beloved (tongue) of God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The pleasures of peace and poise and the greatest bliss are obtained;
chanting and meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, they live. ॥2॥
Lust, anger, greed and pride are eradicated;
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭ ਧੋਏ ॥੩॥
in the company of the Holy, all sins are washed away. ॥3॥
Grant Your grace, O God, Merciful to the meek;
bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ॥4॥75॥144॥
195: The One who gives us what we wear and eat —
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ; ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ. ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
how can we be lazy in remembering Him, O mother? ॥1॥
Forgetting the Master and attached to other affairs,
one throws away the jewel in exchange for a shell. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Forsaking God, one is attached to other greed;
what honour is there in bowing to the slave (Maya)? ॥2॥
They eat delicious delicacies, foods and drinks,
ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੩॥
but the dogs do not know the One who gave them. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, we are faithless to the salt we eat;
forgive us, O God, Searcher of hearts. ॥4॥76॥145॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Meditate within your mind on the feet of God;
this is the cleansing bath at all places of pilgrimage. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Remember the Lord, all day long, O my brother;
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the filth of millions of births shall be washed away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
One who enshrines the Lord's discourse in the heart
obtains all the fruits of the mind's desires. ॥2॥
Life, death and birth — all are approved
for the one in whose heart the Lord God dwells. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, those beings are perfect
who are blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ॥4॥77॥146॥
One who eats and wears (His gifts) and denies (the Giver)
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਹਹਿ; ਦੂਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
is watched over by the messengers of the Righteous Judge. ॥1॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
You have turned your face away from the One who gave you soul and body;
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ; ਭਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through millions of births you shall wander through many species. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Such is the way of the faithless cynic:
whatever he does is all perverse. ॥2॥
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
That Lord and Master, who supports the soul, the breath, the mind and the body —
the cynic forgets Him from his mind. ॥3॥
His sins have so increased that volumes of records are written.
O Nanak, save us, O merciful Lord, Ocean of peace. ॥4॥
O Supreme Lord God, those who come to Your sanctuary
ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ; ਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭੮॥੧੪੭॥
have their bonds cut away, and cross over through the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥78॥147॥
Even one who makes Him a friend out of his own greed —
He fulfils all his wishes and blesses him with the state of liberation. ॥1॥
Everyone should make Him such a friend,
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from whom no one goes away empty-handed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who enshrines Him in the heart, even for his own purpose,
is rid of all pain, suffering and disease. ॥2॥
One whose tongue has acquired the taste for chanting the Lord's Name —
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice;
fruitful is the Blessed Vision of my Lord of the Universe. ॥4॥79॥148॥
Millions of obstacles are removed in an instant
for those who listen to the discourse of the Lord, Har, Har, in the holy company. ॥1॥
ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
They drink in the essence of the Lord's Name, the ambrosial praises,
ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ; ਮਿਟੀ ਖੁਧਿ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and meditating on the Lord's feet, their hunger is gone. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The treasure of all happiness, peace and poise is obtained
by those in whose hearts You dwell, O Lord God. ॥2॥
196: Medicines, mantras and charms are all just ashes.
Enshrine the Creator Lord within your heart. ॥3॥
One who renounces all doubts and meditates on the Supreme Lord God —
says Nanak, this way of life is unshakeable. ॥4॥80॥149॥
By His grace, one meets that Guru;
ਤਿਤੁ ਬਲਿ; ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
by that strength, no disease can touch one. ॥1॥
Contemplating the Lord, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ; ਫਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the sanctuary of the heroic Guru, the records of Death are torn up. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The True Guru has given me the mantra of the Lord's Name;
by this support, my works have been fulfilled. ॥2॥
The full glory of chanting, penance and self-discipline is obtained
when the Guru is merciful and the Lord becomes one's helper. ॥3॥
The Guru has dispelled pride, attachment and doubt;
behold, O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God pervading everywhere. ॥4॥81॥150॥
One who rules through the senses becomes utterly blind;
only when struck by pain does he remember the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
You alone are the glory of Your slave.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ; ਨਰਕਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One engrossed in Maya is dragged to hell. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Gripped by disease, one remembers the Name;
ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਾ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੨॥
but one intoxicated with the poison (of vice) has no place of rest. ॥2॥
One who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet
does not think of any other pleasures. ॥3॥
Forever and ever I remember God, my Master.
O Nanak, meet me, O Lord, Searcher of hearts. ॥4॥82॥151॥
Twenty-four hours a day, the robbers are one's companions;
granting His grace, God has driven them away. ॥1॥
ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਰਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Everyone should savour such a sublime essence of the Lord;
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in an instant, God carries us across. ॥2॥
There are so many bonds that cannot be broken;
remembering the Name, the fruit of liberation is obtained. ॥3॥
ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ; ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
By clever devices, nothing is accomplished by this mortal.
Grant Your grace, that Nanak may sing Your praises. ॥4॥83॥152॥
Those who have obtained the treasure of the Lord's Name
move freely in the world, and all their works are fulfilled. ॥1॥
By great good fortune, one sings the Lord's praises.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Supreme Lord God, as You give, so do we receive. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Enshrine the Lord's feet in your heart;
climbing aboard this boat, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥
Everyone should join the holy company;
ਸਦਾ ਕਲਿਆਣ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
then there is lasting well-being, and pain is not suffered again. ॥3॥
With loving devotion, meditate on the Treasure of virtue;
O Nanak, you shall be honoured in the court of the Lord. ॥4॥84॥153॥
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
The Lord, our Friend, is pervading the water, the land and the sky.
Singing His praises continually, doubts are dispelled. ॥1॥
While rising and while sleeping, the Lord is with you, watching over you.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ; ਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering Him, the fear of Death departs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One in whose heart God's lotus feet abide —
197: The One Lord is my hope, honour, strength and wealth.
ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੀ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੩॥
Within my mind is the support of the True Banker. ॥3॥
The poorest of the poor and the helpless, becoming servants of the Holy,
O Nanak, are protected by God, giving them His hand. ॥4॥85॥154॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ; ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥
Bathing in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes pure;
ਕੋਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਣ; ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਮੂਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
its reward is greater than that of giving charity during millions of eclipses. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ॥
When the Lord's feet abide in the heart,
the sins of countless births are erased. ॥1॥
One who obtains the reward of singing His praises in the holy company
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
does not even see the path of Death. ॥2॥
In thought, word and deed, take the support of the Lord of the Universe;
thus you shall be saved from the poisonous world. ॥3॥
Granting His grace, God has made me His own.
Nanak chants and meditates on the Lord. ॥4॥86॥155॥
Seek the sanctuary of one who knows the Lord;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
the mind and body become cool, imbued with the Lord's feet. ॥1॥
ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
Those who do not enshrine God, the Destroyer of fear, in their minds
ਡਰਪਤ ਡਰਪਤ; ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
pass countless births in terror and fear. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
One in whose heart the Lord's Name abides —
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
all his wishes and works are fulfilled. ॥2॥
Birth, old age and death are in His power;
remember that all-powerful Lord with every breath and morsel. ॥3॥
The One God is my friend, companion and best friend.
O Nanak, the Name of the Master is my support. ॥4॥87॥156॥
While out in the world, they keep Him enshrined in the heart;
returning home, they bring the Lord of the Universe with them. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is with the saints;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their minds and bodies are imbued with the Lord's love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace, they cross over the world-ocean,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
and the sins of countless births are all removed. ॥2॥
Honour and awareness come through the Name of the Lord God,
through the pure teaching of the Perfect Guru. ॥3॥
Meditate on His lotus feet within your heart;
Nanak lives by beholding His glory. ॥4॥88॥157॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Blessed is this place (the heart), where the praises of the Lord of the Universe are sung;
ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God Himself has brought peace and joy to dwell there. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਪਤਿ ਤਹਾ; ਜਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Misfortune is there where the Lord is not remembered.
ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ; ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
There are millions of joys where the Lord's praises are sung. ॥1॥
Forgetting the Lord, one suffers many pains and diseases.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜਮੁ. ਲਗੈ ਨ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
Serving God, Death does not come near. ॥2॥
Very fortunate, steady and eternal is that place
where the Name of God alone is chanted. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is with me;
Nanak has met the Searcher of hearts. ॥4॥89॥158॥
The mortal who meditates on the Lord of the Universe,
educated or uneducated, attains the supreme state. ॥1॥
In the company of the Holy, remember the Lord of the world.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਝੂਠਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, wealth and property are false. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
198: He alone is handsome, clever and wise,
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
who accepts the will of God. ॥2॥
Blessed is his coming into the world,
(who) knows his Lord and Master in each and every heart. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ॥
Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect —
his mind is attached to the Lord's feet. ॥4॥90॥159॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਿਉ; ਸਾਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
The Lord's servant does not associate with the faithless cynic.
ਓਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ; ਓਸੁ. ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One is in the grip of vice, the other in love with the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
It would be like an imaginary rider on a decorated mare,
or a eunuch caressing a woman. ॥1॥
It would be like tying up an ox and trying to milk it,
or riding a cow to chase a tiger. ॥2॥
It would be like taking a sheep and worshipping it as the wish-fulfilling cow,
or going out to shop without any money. ॥3॥
O Nanak, consciously meditate on the Lord's Name.
Remember the Lord Master, your best Friend. ॥4॥91॥160॥
That intellect is pure and steady
which drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, O brother. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਰਿ ਓਟ ॥
Keep the support of the Lord's feet in your heart,
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ; ਹੋਵਤ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and you shall be released from birth and death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਉਪਜੈ ਨ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
Pure is that body in which sin does not arise.
In the Lord's love is pure glory. ॥2॥
In the holy company, vices are eradicated;
this is the greatest blessing of all. ॥3॥
Those imbued with loving devotion to the Lord of the world —
Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those holy ones. ॥4॥92॥161॥
Such is the love for the Lord of the Universe of those
whom He unites with Himself — the perfect, very fortunate ones. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As the wife delights in beholding her husband,
ਤਿਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
so does the Lord's humble servant live by remembering the Name. ॥1॥
As the mother lives by seeing her son,
ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
so is the Lord's humble servant imbued with the Lord, through and through. ॥2॥
As the greedy man delights in beholding his wealth,
ਜਨ. ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
so is the mind of the Lord's humble servant attached to His lotus feet. ॥3॥
May I never forget You, even for an instant, O Great Giver!
You are Nanak's God, the support of his breath of life. ॥4॥93॥162॥
Those humble beings who are attuned to the sublime essence of the Lord
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤੀ ਬੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
are pierced through by loving devotion to His lotus feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All other pleasures look like ashes to them;
without the Name, the world is fruitless. ॥1॥
He Himself pulls them out of the deep dark well (of attachment).
Wondrous and glorious are the praises of the Lord of the Universe. ॥2॥
In the woods, in the grass, in the three worlds, the Lord of the world is pervading.
The expanse of creation is God's; the merciful Lord is with all beings. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, that speech alone is excellent
Every day, bathe in the pool of the Lord's Name.
ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Mix and drink in the supremely delicious ambrosial essence of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name of the Lord of the Universe is pure water;
bathing in it, all one's works are fulfilled. ॥1॥
199: In the company of the saints, there is conversation with God,
and the sins of millions of births are erased. ॥2॥
The holy ones meditate in remembrance and enjoy bliss;
the Lord of supreme bliss pervades their minds and bodies. ॥3॥
The one who obtains the treasure of the Lord's feet —
slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥95॥164॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Do that by which no filth sticks to you,
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and this mind of yours remains awake in the Lord's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remember the One Lord, and do not love duality.
In the company of the saints, chant only the Name. ॥1॥
Rituals, religious rites, vows, fasts and worship —
know that none is of use without the Supreme Lord God. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
who is in love with his God. ॥3॥
That Vaishnav (true devotee) is infinitely sublime,
says Nanak, who has renounced vice. ॥4॥96॥165॥
You may abandon them while yet alive, O madman;
what good can anyone get from them when he is dead? ॥1॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
Remember the Lord of the Universe in mind and body; this is what is pre-ordained.
ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ; ਨ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Maya is of no use at all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who have eaten the drug of sensual pleasures —
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
The treacherous world-ocean is full of terrible pain;
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
without the Lord's Name, how can anyone cross over? ॥3॥
Joining the holy company, save both this world and the next.
O Nanak, worship and adore the Lord's Name. ॥4॥97॥166॥
The beard (pride) that rages at the poor
has been burnt in the fire by the Supreme Lord God. ॥1॥
From the beginning and through the ages, His glory has been manifest;
the slanderer dies, consumed by great suffering. ॥2॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
He is struck down by Him, and no one can save him;
here and hereafter, his reputation is evil. ॥3॥
The Lord hugs His slaves close in His embrace.
Nanak seeks His sanctuary and meditates on the Lord's Name. ॥4॥98॥167॥
The false memorandum (against me) He Himself has proved false,
and the sinner is now suffering in despair. ॥1॥
One who has my Lord of the Universe as his help —
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ; ਜਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Death does not come near him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who speaks falsehood in the True Court —
that blind fool strikes his head with his hands (in regret). ॥2॥
Those who commit sins are afflicted with disease;
God Himself sits as the Judge. ॥3॥
By their own actions, they are bound;
ਦਰਬੁ ਗਇਆ; ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੈ ॥੪॥
all their wealth is gone, along with their life. ॥4॥
Nanak has taken refuge in the Lord's court;
my Creator has preserved my honour. ॥5॥99॥168॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥
The dust of the feet of His humble servants is sweet to the mind
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of the mortal on whom such pre-ordained destiny is written by His grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
200: Through egotistic intellect, the mind is coated with greasy filth;
with the dust of the feet of the Holy, it is scoured clean. ॥1॥
One may wash the body with any amount of water,
ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਤੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
yet its filth is not removed, and it does not become pure. ॥2॥
I have met the True Guru, who is ever merciful;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਕਾਟਿਆ ਭਉ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
remembering, remembering the Lord, the fear of death is cut away. ॥3॥
Liberation, sustenance and the right way of life are all in the Lord's Name.
With loving devotion, Nanak sings His praises. ॥4॥100॥169॥
The servants of the Lord attain the supreme state of life;
meeting them, the soul is illumined. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
O mind, listen with your ears to the remembrance of the Lord,
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and you shall find peace at the Lord's door, O mortal. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord of the world.
O Nanak, beholding His Blessed Vision, one is enraptured. ॥2॥101॥170॥
Peace and tranquillity have come; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has bestowed it.
ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The fever and the sins are gone, O my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With your tongue, ever chant the Lord's Name;
disease is eradicated, and well-being comes. ॥1॥
Reflecting on the virtues of the inaccessible Supreme Lord God,
in the company of the Holy, one is saved. ॥2॥
Sing His pure praises day after day;
the affliction is gone, and His humble friends are saved. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
In thought, word and deed, I meditate on my God.
Slave Nanak has come to Your sanctuary. ॥4॥102॥171॥
The Divine Guru has opened his eyes;
ਭਰਮ ਗਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
doubt is gone, and his service is fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The beautiful Lord has saved him from smallpox;
the Supreme Lord God has granted His grace. ॥1॥
O Nanak, one who chants the Name lives;
in the holy company, he drinks in the Lord's ambrosial nectar. ॥2॥103॥172॥
ਧਨੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ; ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੇਤ ॥
Blessed is that forehead, and blessed are those eyes (devoted to You);
ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਭਗਤ; ਜਿਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥੧॥
blessed are those devotees who are in love with You. ॥1॥
Without the Name, how can anyone find peace?
ਰਸਨਾ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With your tongue, chant the praises of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Nanak, who meditate on the desireless Lord. ॥2॥104॥173॥
You are my counsellor; You are always with me.
You preserve me, caring for me and watching over me. ॥1॥
Such is the Lord, our help in this world and the next;
ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He preserves the honour of His slave, O my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਗੈ ਆਪਿ; ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
He Himself is (our protector) in the world hereafter, and this world is in His power.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Twenty-four hours a day, my mind meditates on the Lord. ॥2॥
He is honoured and approved, and bears the true insignia,
for whom You Yourself issue Your command. ॥3॥
He Himself is the Giver; He Himself is the Cherisher.
ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦੫॥੧੭੪॥
Day after day, O Nanak, dwell upon the Lord's Name. ॥4॥105॥174॥
When the Perfect True Guru becomes merciful,
the Lord of the world comes to dwell in the heart forever. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਤ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Meditating on the Lord, I have found lasting peace;
